prs.title: fix(personhog): make fence preconnect single-flight per partition
evidence: A leader pod booting into many partitions during a rollout could exhaust its 1Gi memory within seconds, and each kill moved those partitions onto the next pod, sustaining a crash loop.
- A partition's slot is claimed before the dial, so repeated convergence passes coalesce to one dial and return counted as `coalesced`.
- Each claim carries its dial's token, and a dial resolves only its own claim. A stale success discards its connection; a stale failure leaves a replacement's claim standing.
Every new test was red-checked: the fix was reverted, the test had to fail for the predicted reason, then pass restored.
